subject: RM_HoseEnd_Modern
label: RM HoseEnd Modern
description: Modern fire-hose end pieces: Coupling_Bare (aluminium Storz coupling at reel/port/joiner) and Mouth (the bare free end's outer face, drawn 0.30 x 0.86 of the hose width on the end of the canvas wrap). The hose lies flat on the ground, so its end must be seen side-on with no bore (C6). Owner 2026-10-23 on the old free end: "the end of this hose looks horrible." NOTE: the assembled panel is an OFFLINE MOCK composed from the textures with the C# sizes (pipe atlas tiles, join/fitting sizes), not an in-game capture; placement of joins in it is approximate.
owner_notes: Owner 2026-10-23: "solid pipe looks pretty horrible actually. We need a whole art review of the Modern style. You made it all enamel red. That was never the intention. ... This is supposed to be stuff you can really see in the real world right now (modern), not just primary colors."
Owner 2026-10-23: "Modern should instead be thought of as "modern consumer / commercial" and industrial is "brutalist""
Owner 2026-10-23: "We should unfortunately regen the pumps and such to have connectors that match the more modern pipe and hose sizes. looks a bit silly." (pipe 0.136 cell wide, hose 0.18 cell flat)
